}}'''Surasa''' is the near-legendary ancestor of Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu|Ethenielle]] of [[Kandor]]. 

== History ==
She believed that being ruler made her so powerful she could control the weather because she sat on the [[Throne of the Clouds]]. She commanded the rain to stop and was drenched for the efforts.
